title: TestResult
description: Outcome of automatically validating a FixSuggestion in a sandbox.

test_run_id.description: Unique identifier for this validation run (UUID).

fix_id.description: ID of the FixSuggestion being validated.

status.description: Overall outcome of the validation run.

reproduction_test.description: Result of the test that reproduces the original failure.

test_code.description: Generated test source code, if newly created.

failed_before_fix.description: Confirms the test reproduces the original bug on unpatched code.

passes_after_fix.description: Confirms the test passes once the fix is applied.

regression_suite.description: Result of running the pre-existing test suite against the patched code.

coverage_delta.description: Change in code coverage percentage caused by the fix + new test, if measured.

execution_log.description: Raw stdout/stderr captured from the sandbox test run.

duration_ms.description: Total time taken to run validation, in milliseconds.

sandbox_image.description: Identifier of the container image used for isolated execution.
